source.title: Best places to get the different herbs? — firsthand Argentleaf milling comment
source.author: LuciferCastielSky

quote: 10 Argentleaf per milling which seems to get 2-15 pigment depending on stats
notes: Author describes a loose, self-reported 2–15 Argentleaf Pigment per 10 Argentleaf mill range and says 12 pigments is the most common outcome. The 12 is a reported MODE, not a measured average or a 12-unit total. No number of completed mills, 0 outcomes, per-cast histogram, profession skill, specialization, herb rank, pigment rank, exact input/output quality-specific item IDs, or patch/build stated. Numeric 50 mills and 500 herbs elsewhere in comment are projected crafting costs, NOT a completed observed study. Preserve the broad range as anecdotal, not a controlled measured min/max or gold-EV baseline. Separate original cohort from Feb 27 kyzenbka comment 6292037.

source.title: Mass prospecting issues — Refulgent Copper five-ore requirement

notes: Firsthand report of in-game error requiring 5 Refulgent Copper Ore when trying to continue queued prospecting. Commenter notes odd residual stacks can interrupt Prospect All; the post's '1000s of ore' is an approximate inventory amount, not completed operations. Independent corroboration of five-ore recipe size; no output yields, Resourcefulness totals, quality rank, skill, specialization or build. Do not infer any completed casts.
